blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: N. Rangasamy's five terms as Chief Minister (spread across 2001-2008, 2011-2016, 2021-2026, and from 2026) make him comparable in political longevity/dominance to other long-serving regional UT/state leaders — a useful biographical anchor for Puducherry's post-Independence political history.

items: Puducherry UT = 4 non-contiguous enclaves: Puducherry & Karaikal (Tamil Nadu-surrounded), Mahe (Kerala-surrounded, only west-coast region), Yanam (Andhra Pradesh-surrounded).
Total area approx 490 sq km; 4 districts; capital: Puducherry town.
North-East Monsoon (Oct-Dec), not South-West Monsoon, is Puducherry's primary rainy season.
Arikamedu = ancient Indo-Roman trade port, identified with 'Poduke' from the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea.
Francois Martin founded French Pondicherry in 1673; French India also included Chandernagore (1673, now West Bengal), Yanam (1723), Mahe (1721-25), Karaikal (1739).
Dupleix (Governor-General from 1742) was recalled in 1754; Pondicherry captured by the British in 1761; restored to France by the Treaty of Paris, 1763; finally restored 1816.
De facto transfer: 1 Nov 1954 (Puducherry Liberation Day). Treaty of Cession signed: 28 May 1956. De jure transfer: 16 Aug 1962. UT constituted with Assembly: 1 July 1963.
Puducherry (French, negotiated 2-stage transfer) vs Goa/Daman/Diu (Portuguese, military annexation, Operation Vijay 1961) — a key comparative fact.
Article 239A (1962) governs Puducherry's Assembly — the oldest of the 3 UT-with-Assembly provisions (Puducherry, Delhi, J&K).
30 elected + up to 3 nominated Assembly seats (33 total).
Current CM: N. Rangasamy (AINRC), 5th term, since 13 May 2026. Current LG: K. Kailashnathan, since 7 Aug 2024.
April 2026 Assembly election: NDA won 18/30 seats (record ~90% turnout).
1 Lok Sabha seat (MP: V. Vaithilingam, INC); 1 Rajya Sabha seat; judiciary under the Madras High Court.
Manufacturing (pharma, chemicals, electronics), tourism, and fisheries are key sectors; GSDP grew ~44% over 5 years to 2025.
Population (2011) approx 12.47 lakh; sex ratio approx 1,037/1,000 (favourable); 4 different regional majority languages (Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu).
Sri Aurobindo Ashram (1926) and Auroville (1968, Matrimandir) are flagship spiritual/cultural institutions; Auroville governed under the Auroville Foundation Act, 1988.
Ousteri Lake = key wetland/bird habitat near Puducherry town.
Revise this chapter last — it consolidates every numeric/name/date fact from Chapters 1-11 in one place for rapid recall.
The single most important sequence to never confuse: 1954 (de facto) -> 1956 (Treaty signed) -> 1962 (de jure) -> 1963 (UT constituted with Assembly).
Always verify current officeholders (LG, CM, MP) closer to your exam date, since these can change.
